description: Pollable stream of fresh Robinhood Chain calls by X accounts with a MEASURED early-call record (default: early_rate >= 0.5, >= 4 calls, coordinated clusters excluded). Each item carries the caller's full measured record + the token's deployer score and FDV. A measured record describes past calls, not future ones. Use since=<cursor from a prior call> to poll for only-new calls. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base.

min_early_rate.description: Only callers whose measured early_rate >= this (default 0.5). Optional.

since.description: captured_at cursor from a prior call — returns only calls newer than it. Optional.

name: robinx_signals
title: Fresh calls by measured early-callers
